name: After § 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 12a. Stresses that immobilised foreign sovereign assets must not be appropriated in breach of sovereign immunity; warns that the creation of ad hoc legal constructions would set a dangerous precedent, undermining the rule of law within the EU, in particular with regard to the security of property rights; underlines that such actions would expose the Member States to significant financial, legal and reputational risks;
